reserveReview.rationale: Write-time re-open 2026-07-28: the Kreston ISRS 4400 AUP (report date 15/06/2026, as-of 31 May 2026) still verifies CNH 39,198,348 of cash held at regulated financial institutions against 39,128,445 AxCNH in circulation for AnchorX Global Limited, confirms the reserve account is in the company's name, and states company confirmation that funds are free from other claims, unrestricted for redemptions, and prohibited from other uses. The public GitHub reserves feed (consumed by anchorx.org/transparency) continues to describe reserve composition disclosures and lists the May 2026 SharePoint report among monthly attestations. Institution names remain undisclosed. Modeled as one 100% CNH cash slice.
